dependencyContract: Three independent lookups per order: price cents, stock quantity, shipping cents. Same service code and delay in every arm. Each call uses a fresh loopback TCP socket; modeled dependency capacity is stated per experiment.
outputContract: Per order: price + shipping when stock > 0; otherwise -1. All result arrays are independently verified in Python.
environmentNotes: Shared Apple developer workstation; desktop/browser/website may remain running
Java and PHP/DB full measurement windows coordinated to avoid overlap
Host load recorded for every run; no fixed CPU quota or memory RSS measurement
limitations: Synthetic newly written legacy-pattern reproduction, not a customer migration
25ms is a dependency model parameter, not measured third-party latency
Primary comparison changes architecture and concurrency as well as runtime; runtime-only and same-concurrency platform controls are retained
Virtual threads are not faster CPU threads; peakPlatformThreads counts JVM platform threads, not total virtual tasks
p95Ms is median of per-run order completion p95, including batch queueing, not pooled p95
No monetary cost, production traffic, security score or guaranteed improvement conclusion
Installed Java 8 patch is old; this is not a comparison to current patched Java8
Warmup stability and isolated production-hardware repeat remain outside this local experiment
